strings.zh: 这里是１０号道路{NEWLINE}里面　岩山隧道
你终于来了么？{SCROLL}你知道吗？{NEWLINE}我一直都好想见你……{CLEAR}好想见你呀……{SCROLL}拜托你不要走……
strings.en: So you’ve finally come?{SCROLL}You know, I’ve wanted to see you all{NEWLINE}this time...{SCROLL}I’ve wanted to see you so much...{SCROLL}Please don’t go...
strings.notes: The ghost of the girl Lavender (紫苑, the Lavender Town legend in 0472/0473; named Lavender so the town-name story works in English).
